t: You're looking at the Great Eastern Hotel, now the Andaz London Liverpool Street, a five star hotel just south of Liverpool Street station. It was built in 1884 as the Great Eastern Hotel. The building was extensively renovated and expanded between 1899 and 1901, and again in 2000, when Terence Conran co-owned it. Hyatt has owned it since 2006. The original architect was Edward Middleton Barry, a nineteenth-century English architect and Royal Academician.
